mentions.name: The Time Game
mentions.description: A multiplayer card/board game built with Unity (C#) using Unity's Relay and Lobby services, aiming for the complexity and mind-bending gameplay that fans of Magic and Hearthstone would appreciate.
mentions.source_excerpt: I've been working on a multiplayer card/board game with some friends! We've been using Unity (C#) and its services like Relay and Lobby.
